<contract name="northbridge.md">
# Northbridge Software — QualityLoop Subscription (fictional excerpt)

## Term and Renewal
Current term ends February 28, 2027. The subscription renews automatically for twelve (12) months unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least forty-five (45) days before the end of the term.

## Price Changes
Renewal fees may increase by no more than four percent (4%) per renewal.

## User Counts
Named users above the licensed quantity are invoiced quarterly at the contracted unit rate.

## Data
Customer data can be exported in CSV at any time and for thirty (30) days after termination.
</contract>

watch_outs: The subscription renews automatically for 12 months unless you give notice at least 45 days before February 28, 2027, which is by about January 14, 2027.
Renewal fees can rise by up to 4% at each renewal, so budget for it or negotiate before the notice deadline.
Users above the licensed count are billed quarterly at the unit rate, so check your named-user count before renewal.
